## 9. Bonus  
Master Manual for DDOs and Head of Offices - Part - I ]

- (ii) Ad hoc Bonus  
Conditions common to both the type of Bonus :

2. Quantum of Bonus.Every year bonus granted as equivalent to emoluments for certain number of days for the relevant financial year.
